(Qty: 13 Units) · Processor: Intel Core i5 (12th or 13th Generation - e.g., i5-12500 / i5-13400) or AMD Ryzen 5 Proces sor with integrated graphics. · Operating System: Pre-loaded Windows 11 Professional (64-bit) with digital OEM license/recovery media. · Chipset & Motherboard: OEM proprietary motherboard with Intel/AMD chipset supporting TPM 2.0 ( Trusted Platform Module) for hardware security. · Memory (RAM): Minimum 8 GB DDR4 (3200 MHz) or DDR5 (4800 MHz+) RAM, expandable up to 64 GB via vacant DIMM slot(s). · Storage: Minimum 256 GB M.2 NVMe PCIe Solid State Drive (SSD) for lightning-fast boot and data ac cess. · Display / Monitor: Minimum 19-inch Full HD (1920 x 1080 resolution) LED Backlit IPS Monitor with A nti-Glare, TCO Certified, with HDMI & DisplayPort cables. · Keyboard & Mouse: OEM Branded USB Business Keyboard & USB Optical Scroll Mouse (same brand as desktop). · Ports & Connectivity: Minimum 6x USB ports (at least 2x USB 3.2 Gen 1), 1x RJ-45 Ethernet port (G igabit LAN), HDMI/DisplayPort, Audio combo jack, built-in Wi-Fi & Bluetooth. · Warranty & Support: Minimum 02 Years Comprehensive On-Site Manufacturer Warranty covering p arts, labor, and display. · Brand: Acer, HP, Lenovo, Dell, or Asus or any reputed make. · Office Productivity Suite: Pre-loaded / Licensed Latest Microsoft Office & MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint. · Installation & Commissioning: Free on-site unboxing, hardware assembly, cable setup, Windows 1 1 Pro & MS Office activation, and complete testing by the vendor/OEM engineer. Part 2: Power Backup UPS System. (Qty: 13 Units) · Type & Capacity: 1 kVA / 600W–800W (or specify 1 kVA / 800W for Online UPS / 1 kVA / 600W for Line-Interactive UPS) Line-Interactive / Online UPS with Automatic Voltage Regulation (AVR) and pure si ne wave output, designed to protect all 13 systems against surges and power cuts. · Battery Backup: Adequate backup time to ensure safe system shutdown and operational stability. · Warranty: Minimum 2 Years comprehensive warranty on unit and internal batteries. Part 3: Prayer Hall Music & PA System. (Qty: 01 Units) · Amplifier / Mixer: Portable PA Amplifier (approx. 60W-120W) with Bluetooth, USB playback, FM, and multiple microphone inputs. · Microphones: 1 Wired & 1 Cordless Dynamic Mike with heavy-duty stands. · Speakers: Column Speaker optimized for crisp vocal clarity during morning prayers and assemblies. .
